in_marathi.name: Makrand
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Time
in_marathi.long_meaning: Makrand हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Makrand is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'Mahakala' or 'Mahakalp', meaning 'Lord of Time'. In Hindu mythology, Mahakala is a form of Shiva, the god of destruction, who is also considered the lord of time. The name Makrand is believed to evoke the qualities of power, stability, and timelessness.
